descriptionByLocale.it:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes:
• New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.
• Performance - all ui components that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
• Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Frontend Development team is responsible for building all the interactions with API services with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base. Responsibilities Collaborate with the team to work on the development of the Bitfinex KYC webapps. Including:
• New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies.
• Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
• Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools.
• Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors
• Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.
• With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend.
• Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture.
• Comfortable with high-availability concepts.
• Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
• Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these.
• Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment
• Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools.
• Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs.
• Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life.
• Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Descrizione: Unisciti a Tether e modella il futuro della finanza digitale Da Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, ma stiamo aprendo una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia permettono alle aziende—dagli exchange e wallet ai processori di pagamento e agli ATM—di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i token garantiti da riserva tra le blockchain. Sfruttando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether ti permette di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere token digitali in modo istantaneo, sicuro e globale, tutto a una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innova con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra suite di prodotti innovativa presenta la stablecoin più affidabile al mondo, USDT, su cui si affidano centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme a servizi pionieristici di tokenizzazione di asset digitali. Ma questo è solo l'inizio: Tether Power: Favorendo una crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l'energia in eccesso per il mining di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche ecologiche in strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diversificate. Tether Data: Alimentando innovazioni nell'IA e nella tecnologia peer-to-peer, riduciamo i costi infrastrutturali e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET, la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione di dati sicura e privata. Tether Education: Democratizzando l'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, diamo agli individui il potere di prosperare nelle economie digitale e gig, promuovendo la crescita globale e le opportunità. Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, costruendo un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una potenza globale del talento, che lavora da remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se sei appassionato di lasciare il segno nel settore fintech, questa è la tua opportunità per collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, superando i limiti e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti rapidamente, siamo rimasti snelli e abbiamo assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se hai ottime capacità comunicative in inglese e sei pronto a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto giusto per te. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? Informazioni sul lavoro Il Senior Technical Product Manager sarà responsabile della leadership complessiva di prodotto di Hadron, inclusa la visione del prodotto, la definizione della roadmap e l'esecuzione della consegna. Il ruolo rappresenta il punto unico di responsabilità per la piattaforma nel soddisfare le esigenze istituzionali dei clienti, l'erogazione ingegneristica e i requisiti normativi/di conformità. A differenza di un ruolo tradizionale di Product Manager, questa posizione richiede un'autorità decisionale chiara per:
• Stabilire e far rispettare le priorità della roadmap, incluso il contrasto su richieste non essenziali.
• Coordinarsi con partner ingegneristici esterni e mantenere la disciplina di ambito.
• Risolvere i conflitti tra richieste del cliente, fattibilità tecnica e vincoli di conformità.
• Prendere decisioni su integrazioni, funzionalità di prodotto e rilascio.
• Garantire che lo sviluppo del prodotto sia allineato all'architettura a lungo termine e alla scalabilità della piattaforma Hadron. Contesto critico Hadron serve clienti istituzionali a livello globale con requisiti di tokenizzazione diversi e spesso contrastanti, inclusi diverse classi di asset, reti blockchain, framework di conformità e modelli di distribuzione. Il Product Manager deve gestire questa complessità mantenendo una strategia di prodotto chiara, dando priorità senza pietà e prevenendo l'espansione dell'ambito. Il ruolo richiede una forte responsabilità e la capacità di prendere decisioni difficili di priorità in un ambiente istituzionale in rapida evoluzione. Reportistica e Collaborazione Riporta a: VP Prodotto Il Product Manager lavora in stretta collaborazione con il Head of Expansion & Product Advisor di Hadron per garantire un forte allineamento tra la domanda istituzionale dei clienti, le opportunità di mercato e la roadmap del prodotto Hadron. Il Responsabile dell'Espansione e del Consulente di Prodotto fornisce feedback di mercato continuo basato su coinvolgimenti istituzionali con i clienti e partnership strategiche, assicurando che lo sviluppo del prodotto rifletta la reale domanda del mercato. Il Product Manager è responsabile di tradurre questi input in priorità di prodotto, decisioni sulla roadmap ed esecuzione ingegneristica. Iniziative principali di roadmap, richieste di funzionalità guidate dai clienti e nuove integrazioni dovrebbero essere allineate tra il Product Manager e il Head of Expansion & Product Advisor prima dell'implementazione. Il candidato ideale Stiamo cercando specificamente candidati che abbiano operato a livello senior e che possano dimostrare una profonda e pratica esperienza alla tokenizzazione e all'infrastruttura finanziaria tradizionale. Dovresti essere in grado di riconoscerti nella maggior parte dei seguenti aspetti: Tokenizzazione, end-to-end
• Hai personalmente costruito, spedito o posseduto un prodotto di tokenizzazione — dall'onboarding degli asset e specifiche degli smart contract fino all'integrazione della custodia, alla gestione della tabelle di capitalizzazione degli investitori e ai meccanismi di trasferimento secondari.
• Puoi percorrere l'intero ciclo di vita del token (emissione, trasferimento, riscatto, azioni societarie, bruciatura) senza dover cercare nulla e comprendere i compromessi tra i diversi approcci di implementazione.
• Comprendi i modelli di custodia: la differenza tra autocustodia, modelli di custodia qualificati, strutture omnibus vs. portafogli segregati, e cosa significa ciascuno per il rischio di conformità e operativo.
• Hai conoscenze pratiche delle meccaniche di insediamento on-chain e di come interagiscono con i binari tradizionali T+1/T+2 (DTCC, Euroclear, SWIFT).
• Sei fluente negli standard dei token su più catene e sai quando ricorrere a ERC-20, ERC-1400 o strutture proprietarie, e perché. Profondità TradFi
• Hai una solida comprensione di come funziona l'infrastruttura finanziaria istituzionale: come sono strutturati e amministrati i fondi, come i broker-dealer liquidano e liquidano, come le banche gestiscono i rapporti di trust e affidamento e come opera il prime brokerage.
• Comprendi gli strumenti tokenizzati: fondi del mercato monetario, obbligazioni, credito strutturato, azioni, immobili, materie prime, incluso come ciascuno viene prezzato, trasferito e gestito nel mondo tradizionale.
• Sei a tuo agio con i quadri normativi rilevanti per asset tokenizzati come MiCA, Reg D/S, MAS MAS notice, VARA e puoi identificare i vincoli di conformità che devono essere codificati nel design del prodotto.
• Puoi leggere e interpretare rapidamente documenti istituzionali: RFP, term sheet, accordi di affidamento e questionari di due diligence, e tradurli in requisiti di prodotto senza un'ampia supervisione. Domanda istituzionale, traduzione rapida
• Hai lavorato direttamente con clienti istituzionali come gestori di asset, banche, fondi sovrani, family office come product owner primario, e sai come gestire le loro aspettative ed estrarre segnali dal rumore.
• Puoi ascoltare un nuovo caso d'uso istituzionale o un requisito di integrazione complesso e valutare rapidamente fattibilità, portata e priorità, senza bisogno di giorni per ricercare le basi.
• Hai esperienza nel distinguere tra richieste che rivelano vere lacune di prodotto e quelle che sono personalizzazioni personalizzate per il cliente e sai come gestire entrambe senza compromettere la roadmap. Responsabilità Chiave Strategia di Prodotto e Roadmap
• Definire e mantenere la roadmap del prodotto Adron.
• Dare priorità alle iniziative di prodotto in base alla domanda di mercato, alla fattibilità tecnica e all'impatto sul business.
• Mantenere una visione chiara del prodotto per Hadron su molteplici classi di asset e reti blockchain.
• Garantire la scalabilità a lungo termine della piattaforma e la coerenza del prodotto. Sviluppo e Consegna del Prodotto
• Tradurre le esigenze aziendali e di mercato in requisiti chiari del prodotto.
• Mantenere l'arretrato del prodotto e le priorità di sviluppo.
• Coordinare i cicli di sviluppo e il rilascio delle funzionalità.
• Garantire la consegna tempestiva delle tappe della roadmap. Coordinamento ingegneristico
• Agiscono come interfaccia primaria tra prodotto e ingegneria.
• Coordinare il lavoro di sviluppo con ingegneri interni e partner tecnologici esterni.
• Mantenere una documentazione chiara delle funzionalità del prodotto, delle API e delle capacità della piattaforma.
• Monitorare le prestazioni della piattaforma, i bug e i miglioramenti tecnici. Feedback Cliente e Integrazione
• Raccogliere e strutturare feedback da clienti istituzionali e team interni.
• Identificare le sfide ricorrenti di integrazione e tradurle in miglioramenti del prodotto.
• Migliorare i flussi di lavoro di onboarding e l'esperienza degli sviluppatori. Requisiti
• 5+ anni di esperienza nella gestione di prodotto o nella proprietà del prodotto, con almeno 3 anni in asset digitali, tokenizzazione o infrastrutture finanziarie.
• Esperienza pratica dimostrata nella spedizione di un prodotto di tokenizzazione o RWA, con responsabilità per l'intero ciclo di vita del token.
• Profonda conoscenza operativa dell'infrastruttura dei mercati dei capitali TradFi, inclusi regolamenti di liquidazione, custodia, compensazione e strutture dei fondi.
• Comprovata capacità di analizzare rapidamente i requisiti istituzionali e tradurli in decisioni di prodotto concrete.
• Esperienza nella gestione di partner ingegneristici esterni e nell'applicazione della disciplina di ambito in programmi complessi e multi-stakeholder.
• Alfabetizzazione normativa in almeno due principali quadri di tokenizzazione (MiCA, MAS, SEC, VARA o equivalente).

About the job The Senior Technical Product Manager will be responsible for the overall product leadership of Hadron, including product vision, roadmap definition, and delivery execution. The role serves as the single point of accountability for the platform to serve institutional client needs, engineering delivery, and regulatory/compliance requirements. Unlike a traditional Product Manager role, this position requires clear decision-making authority to:
• Set and enforce roadmap priorities, including pushing back on non-essential requests.
• Coordinate with external engineering partners and maintain scope discipline.
• Resolve conflicts between client requests, technical feasibility, and compliance constraints.
• Make go/no-go decisions on integrations, product features, and releases.
• Ensure product development aligns with the long-term architecture and scalability of the Hadron platform. Critical Context Hadron serves institutional clients globally with diverse and often conflicting tokenization requirements, including different asset classes, blockchain networks, compliance frameworks, and distribution models. The Product Manager must manage this complexity by maintaining a clear product strategy, prioritizing ruthlessly, and preventing scope creep. The role requires strong ownership and the ability to make difficult prioritization decisions in a fast-moving institutional environment. Reporting & Collaboration Reports to: VP Product The Product Manager works in close partnership with the Head of Expansion & Product Advisor for Hadron to ensure strong alignment between institutional client demand, market opportunities, and the Hadron product roadmap. Head of Expansion & Product Advisor provides continuous market feedback based on institutional client engagements and strategic partnerships, ensuring that product development reflects real market demand. The Product Manager is responsible for translating these inputs into product priorities, roadmap decisions, and engineering execution. Major roadmap initiatives, client-driven feature requests, and new integrations are expected to be aligned between the Product Manager and the Head of Expansion & Product Advisor before implementation. The Ideal Candidate We are specifically looking for candidates who have operated at a senior level and can demonstrate deep, hands-on exposure to tokenization and traditional financial infrastructure. You should be able to recognise yourself in most of the following: Tokenization, end-to-end
• You have personally built, shipped, or owned a tokenization product — from asset onboarding and smart contract specification through to custody integration, investor cap table management, and secondary transfer mechanics.
• You can walk through the full token lifecycle (issuance, transfer, redemption, corporate actions, burn) without needing to look anything up, and you understand the tradeoffs between different implementation approaches.
• You understand custody models: the difference between self-custody, qualified custodian models, omnibus vs. segregated wallet structures, and what each means for compliance and operational risk.
• You have practical knowledge of on-chain settlement mechanics and how they interact with traditional T+1/T+2 settlement rails (DTCC, Euroclear, SWIFT).
• You are fluent in token standards across multiple chains and understand when to reach for ERC-20, ERC-1400, or proprietary structures, and why. TradFi depth
• You have a strong grasp of how institutional financial infrastructure works: how funds are structured and administered, how broker-dealers clear and settle, how banks manage trust and custody relationships, and how prime brokerage operates.
• You understand the instruments being tokenized: money market funds, bonds, structured credit, equities, real estate, commodities including how each is priced, transferred, and serviced in the traditional world.
• You are comfortable with regulatory frameworks relevant to tokenized assets such as MiCA, Reg D/S, MAS MAS notice, VARA and can identify the compliance constraints that must be encoded into product design.
• You can read and rapidly interpret institutional documents: RFPs, term sheets, custody agreements, and due diligence questionnaires, and translate them into product requirements without extensive hand-holding. Institutional demand, rapid translation
• You have worked directly with institutional clients such as asset managers, banks, sovereign funds, family offices as the primary product owner, and you know how to manage their expectations and extract signals from noise.
• You can hear a new institutional use case or a complex integration requirement and rapidly assess feasibility, scope, and priority, without needing days to research the basics.
• You have experience distinguishing between requests that reveal genuine product gaps and those that are bespoke client customisations and you know how to handle both without derailing the roadmap. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy & Roadmap
• Define and maintain the Hadron product roadmap.
• Prioritize product initiatives based on market demand, technical feasibility, and business impact.
• Maintain a clear product vision for Hadron across multiple asset classes and blockchain networks.
• Ensure long-term platform scalability and product coherence. Product Development & Delivery
• Translate business and market needs into clear product requirements.
• Maintain the product backlog and development priorities.
• Coordinate development cycles and feature releases.
• Ensure timely delivery of roadmap milestones. Engineering Coordination
• Act as the primary interface between product and engineering.
• Coordinate development work with internal engineers and external technology partners.
• Maintain clear documentation of product features, APIs, and platform capabilities.
• Track platform performance, bugs, and technical improvements. Client & Integration Feedback
• Collect and structure feedback from institutional clients and internal teams.
• Identify recurring integration challenges and translate them into product improvements.
• Improve onboarding workflows and developer experience.
• 5+ years of experience in product management or product ownership, with at least 3 years in digital assets, tokenization, or financial infrastructure.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience shipping a tokenization or RWA product, with accountability for the full token lifecycle.
• Deep, working knowledge of TradFi capital markets infrastructure including settlement, custody, clearing, fund structures.
• Proven ability to rapidly parse institutional requirements and translate them into actionable product decisions.

• Regulatory literacy across at least two major tokenization frameworks (MiCA, MAS, SEC, VARA, or equivalent).
• Excellent written and spoken English. Able to author crisp product specs, client-facing documentation, and executive summaries. Nice to have:

• Experience with institutional client onboarding workflows in a regulated context. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Maintenir le backlog produit et les priorités de développement.
• Coordonner les cycles de développement et la mise à disposition des fonctionnalités.

• Coordonner le travail de développement avec les ingénieurs internes et les partenaires technologiques externes.
• Maintenir une documentation claire des fonctionnalités du produit, des API et des capacités de la plateforme.
• Suivre les performances des plateformes, les bugs et les améliorations techniques. Retour client et intégration

• Identifier les défis récurrents d’intégration et les traduire en améliorations produit.

• Expérience pratique démontrée dans la livraison d’un produit de tokenisation ou RWA, avec responsabilité pour l’ensemble du cycle de vie du jeton.
• Connaissance approfondie et pratique de l’infrastructure des marchés de capitaux TradFi, y compris le règlement, la garde, la compensation et les structures de fonds.
• Capacité avérée à analyser rapidement les exigences institutionnelles et à les traduire en décisions produit exploitables.
• Expérience de la gestion de partenaires d’ingénierie externes et de l’application de la discipline du périmètre dans des programmes complexes et multipartites.
• Littératie réglementaire à travers au moins deux grands cadres de tokenisation (MiCA, MAS, SEC, VARA ou équivalent).
• Excellent anglais écrit et parlé. Capable de rédiger des spécifications produites concises, une documentation destinée aux clients et des résumés exécutifs. C’est agréable à avoir :
• Expérience préalable dans une banque, un gestionnaire d’actifs, un dépositaire ou une fintech réglementée dans un rôle dans un produit, une technologie ou un marché.
• Expérience pratique avec plusieurs standards de jetons et réseaux blockchain en contexte de production.
• Expérience de conception ou d’intégration avec des API de garde, des systèmes d’agents de transfert ou des plateformes d’administration de fonds.
• Compréhension des mécanismes de conformité on-chain : liste blanche, restrictions de transfert, crochets KYC/AML au niveau des contrats intelligents.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job As a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in building and scaling our GPU-accelerated cloud services platform. You'll work on both the backend infrastructure that powers AI/ML workloads at scale and the frontend interfaces that make these capabilities accessible to developers and data scientists. This position requires deep technical expertise in distributed systems, strong backend development skills, and the ability to create intuitive user experiences. You'll be joining a team that's pushing the boundaries of decentralized AI infrastructure, working on everything from Kubernetes orchestration and managed inference services to API design and real-time monitoring dashboards. Your work will directly impact how developers interact with and deploy AI models in production environments. Responsibilities
• Backend Development: Design and implement robust backend services and APIs that handle AI model inference, resource orchestration, and workload distribution across distributed GPU infrastructure
• Frontend Implementation: Build responsive and intuitive web interfaces for training job management, model deployment workflows, and real-time monitoring dashboards using modern JavaScript frameworks
• Distributed Systems Architecture: Contribute to the design and implementation of distributed systems using peer-to-peer technologies (Holepunch stack)
• API Design & Integration: Develop and maintain APIs that support both synchronous and asynchronous inference patterns, ensuring compatibility with industry standards
• Platform Reliability: Implement monitoring, logging, and telemetry solutions to ensure high availability and performance of the platform services
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with DevOps, AI/ML engineers, and product teams to deliver integrated solutions that meet technical and business requirements
• Code Quality & Best Practices: Maintain high standards for code quality through peer reviews, testing, and documentation while championing security best practices
• 5+ years of experience in fullstack development with strong emphasis on backend systems
• Expert-level proficiency in Node.js/JavaScript for backend development and React frontend framework
• Proven experience building and scaling distributed systems or event-driven architectures
• Strong understanding of API design and implementation, including authentication, rate limiting, and versioning
• Experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes)
• Proficiency with databases, and a deep understanding of data modeling and optimization
• Solid understanding of networking, security principles, and best practices for production systems
• Experience with real-time data streaming and RPC implementations
• Ability to work independently in a remote environment and communicate effectively across time zones Preferred:
• Experience with peer-to-peer technologies (Hyperswarm, libp2p, WebRTC) or similar distributed communication protocols
• Familiarity with AI/ML inference APIs and OpenAI-compatible endpoints
• Previous experience building AI SaaS or PaaS platforms
• Knowledge of GPU resource management and ML framework infrastructure
• Experience with message queuing systems (Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka)
• Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack)
• Understanding of WebAssembly or edge computing paradigms
• Contributions to open-source projects in relevant domains Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Questo ruolo offre un'eccellente opportunità per acquisire esperienza pratica nell'esecuzione di operazioni e nella gestione degli investimenti in un ambiente dinamico e frenetico. • Aufgaben als Vorstandsbeobachter und die Nachverfolgung von Meilensteinen durch. Unterstützen Sie den Ausbau und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Investment-Betriebsinfrastruktur des Tether RISE-Fonds rund um Anlageprozesse, Dealflow-Verfolgung, Portfoliomanagementsysteme und Berichtsrhythmen. Koordination und Diskussion mit dem Expansionsteam zur Verbesserung der Strategie des Tether RISE-Fonds durch die Arbeit an Inputs im Zusammenhang mit Marktinformationen, thematischer Abdeckung und Ökosystemkartierung. Diese Qualifikationen gelten als Grundlage für das Maß an analytischer Genauigkeit und Investment-Governance, das in dieser Rolle erwartet wird. Carta), CRM/Deal-Flow-Plattformen (z. B. Affinity, Salesforce) und Datenraumverwaltung. Vertrautheit mit den Tools des Portfoliomanagementsystems ist von Vorteil. descriptionByLocale.fr: Rejoignez Tether et façonnez l'avenir de la finance numérique Chez Tether, nous ne nous contentons pas de créer des produits, nous sommes les pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises (des bourses et portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques) d'intégrer de manière transparente les jetons adossés à des réserves dans les blockchains. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et à l'échelle mondiale, le tout pour une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, garantissant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innovez avec Tether Tether Finance : notre suite de produits innovants comprend le stablecoin le plus fiable au monde, l'USDT, sur lequel s'appuient des centaines de millions de personnes dans le monde, ainsi que des services pionniers de tokenisation d'actifs numériques. Mais ce n’est qu’un début : Tether Power : favorisant une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l’énergie excédentaire pour l’extraction de Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques respectueuses de l’environnement dans des installations de pointe et géodiverses. Tether Data : En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie peer-to-peer, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET, notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Tether Education : en démocratisant l'accès à un apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous permettons aux individus de s'épanouir dans l'économie numérique et des petits boulots, stimulant ainsi la croissance et les opportunités mondiales. Tether Evolution : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, en créant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une centrale mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance depuis tous les coins du monde. Si vous souhaitez vous démarquer dans le domaine de la fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les limites et d'établir de nouvelles normes. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide, sommes restés minces et avons assuré notre place de leader du secteur. Si vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est fait pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? À propos du poste En tant qu'associé en investissement au sein de l'équipe Investissements d'expansion chez Tether, vous contribuerez à nos investissements en capital-investissement et en capital-risque, en vous concentrant sur les investissements stratégiques clés et les catalyseurs d'expansion. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les membres supérieurs de l'équipe, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l'analyse, la diligence raisonnable et le suivi des sociétés potentielles. Ce rôle offre une excellente opportunité d'acquérir une expérience pratique dans l'exécution de transactions et la gestion d'investissements dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution rapide. Responsabilités Soutien à l'exécution des transactions et à la gestion des transactions Soutenir le cycle de vie complet des transactions d'investissement, depuis la feuille de conditions jusqu'à la clôture, en coordonnant les flux de travail juridiques, financiers et stratégiques avec les équipes internes et les conseillers externes. Structurer et négocier les conditions des transactions (valorisation, droits de gouvernance, prorata, droits d'information) en garantissant l'alignement avec l'appétit pour le risque et les seuils de rendement du fonds RISE. Due Diligence Synthétiser les résultats de la diligence dans une analyse de qualité investissement, tester les hypothèses clés, identifier les risques importants et articuler des stratégies d'atténuation. Coordonner des analyses approfondies spécialisées (réglementaire, cyber, AML/KYC, le cas échéant pour les objectifs d'investissement) en fonction des besoins du fonds RISE. Préparation du comité d'investissement et gouvernance Notes de l'auteur du comité d'investissement - y compris l'articulation de la thèse, la taille du marché, le positionnement concurrentiel, la modélisation de la valorisation, les matrices de risque et les conditions proposées. Maintenir des normes de documentation rigoureuses pour tous les documents de Venture IC, garantissant l’auditabilité et la cohérence avec le cadre de gouvernance interne et les directives d’investissement du fonds. Gestion de portefeuille et création de valeur Servir de principal responsable de la relation pour les sociétés de portefeuille assignées après la clôture, en effectuant des enregistrements structurés, des tâches d'observateur au conseil d'administration et le suivi des jalons. Soutenir l'équipe de reporting dans le suivi des KPI financiers et opérationnels, en signalant les points d'inflexion, les problèmes liés aux engagements ou les opportunités de suivi du fonds RISE. Travailler aux côtés de l'équipe de reporting et des finances pour produire des rapports périodiques sur le portefeuille pour les parties prenantes internes et la haute direction, en maintenant des notes d'évaluation et des commentaires stratégiques précis. Développement de la plateforme Rise Fund Soutenir le développement et l'amélioration continue de l'infrastructure opérationnelle d'investissement du fonds Tether RISE autour des processus d'investissement, du suivi des flux de transactions, des systèmes de gestion de portefeuille et des cadences de reporting. Coordination et discussion avec l'équipe d'expansion pour améliorer la stratégie du fonds Tether RISE en travaillant sur les apports liés à l'intelligence du marché, à la couverture thématique et à la cartographie de l'écosystème. Compétences analytiques Solides capacités analytiques avec la capacité d'interpréter des données financières, d'effectuer des analyses de valorisation et d'évaluer les opportunités d'investissement. Compétences en communication : faire preuve d'excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais, avec la capacité de communiquer efficacement les conclusions et les recommandations à la haute direction et aux comités d'investissement. Éducation : Baccalauréat (minimum) en finance, économie, administration des affaires ou dans une discipline étroitement liée. Un diplôme de maîtrise (MBA, MSc Finance ou équivalent) est fortement préféré. Certification professionnelle : titulaire du titre CFA ou CAIA requis (ou progression démontrable vers l'achèvement). Ces qualifications sont considérées comme la base du niveau de rigueur analytique et de gouvernance des investissements attendu dans ce rôle. Expérience : 3 à 5 ans d'expérience directement pertinente dans les domaines du capital-risque, du capital-investissement, de la banque d'investissement ou du développement d'entreprise, avec une partie importante de cette période consacrée à l'exécution et à la clôture de transactions. Compétences techniques et analytiques : Modélisation financière avancée ; bonne maîtrise d'Excel et de PowerPoint; connaissance pratique des outils de gestion des tables de plafond (par exemple Carta), des plateformes CRM/flux de transactions (par exemple Affinity, Salesforce) et de la gestion de salles de données. La connaissance des outils du système de gestion de portefeuille est un plus. Compétences en communication : faire preuve d'excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais, avec la capacité de communiquer efficacement les conclusions et les recommandations à la haute direction et aux comités d'investissement. Connaissance de l'industrie : Solide compréhension de la dynamique des investissements en capital-risque et en phase de croissance. Connaissance du secteur des services financiers, y compris les cadres réglementaires, les écosystèmes fintech et les contraintes d'investissement institutionnels. Langue : Une maîtrise professionnelle complète de l'anglais (écrit et oral) est requise. Toute autre langue est un plus. Informations importantes pour les candidats Les escroqueries au recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus courantes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder les points suivants à l'esprit lorsque vous postulez à des postes : postulez uniquement via nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plateformes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication contraire. Tous les postes ouverts sont répertoriés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/ Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont des profils LinkedIn vérifiés. En cas de doute, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web. Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entretiens via WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toutes les communications se font via les e-mails et les plateformes officielles de l'entreprise. Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toutes les communications de notre part proviendront d'e-mails se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io. Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu’un demande des informations financières personnelles ou un paiement à tout moment du processus d’embauche, il s’agit d’une arnaque. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter via notre site officiel.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We’re looking for a Technical Lead to lead our development efforts in building cross platform peer-to-peer applications using the Pear Runtime and the broader ecosystem created by Holepunch. You’ll define technical direction, support engineers in day-to-day development, and act as the main liaison with Holepunch engineers - translating upstream developments into actionable work, coordinating releases, and contributing to the evolution of our peer-to-peer ecosystem. What you’ll work on
• Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers.
• Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date.
• Build and maintain flagship desktop (Electron) and mobile (React Native) applications that run fully peer-to-peer with zero central servers.
• Design beautiful, performant cross-platform UX for file sharing, messaging, video calls, and collaborative tools.
• Integrate and extend the Pear Runtime / Holepunch stack (Hypercore, Hyperdrive, Hyperswarm, etc.).
• Ship new features rapidly, participate in code reviews, write tests, and optimize performance.
• Help external partners and the open-source community build on the platform.
• Occasionally contribute improvements and bug fixes back to the underlying open-source modules. Responsibilities
• Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers.
• Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date.
• Translate product requirements into clear technical plans and architectures aligned with the Holepunch stack.
• Ensure our applications follow a modular approach and are designed according to best practices.
• Coordinate internal and external documentation and training plans.
• Coordinate consolidated feedback from our dev team and external projects to the Holepunch team
• Guide and mentor the different engineering teams.
• Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love)
• A strong background in building and managing modular codebases and creating reusable npm modules.
• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
• Experience leading small development teams and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.
• Experience with mobile application stores, browser stores or Desktop stores.
• Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems
• Proven experience designing and building local-first applications where the local data model is the primary source of truth.
• Hands-on experience with local-first data technologies (storage, conflict resolution, event sourcing, etc.)
• Familiarity with cross-platform packaging & deployment
• Familiarity with end-to-end encryption and secure local storage.
• Solid grasp of asynchronous programming, networking, and data synchronization concepts
• Proficiency with Git, CI/CD and collaborative open-source workflows.
• Excellent communication skills (fully remote, global team) Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Rejoignez Tether et façonnez l'avenir de la finance numérique Chez Tether, nous ne nous contentons pas de créer des produits, nous sommes les pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, garantissant la confiance dans chaque transaction.
